name: hip crunch (knees bent)
description: A reverse-crunch style move lifting the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and lifted over your hips.
Place your hands at your sides.
Curl your hips off the floor by bringing your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Use your abs instead of swinging your legs.
